messages:
ari (New Hire): hey team — starting next Mon in Toronto. couple quick things: 1) when do benefits start if you join mid-month? 2) can i opt out of company supplemental private dental/vision? 3) i paid movers and some visa paperwork — does redwood reimburse moving/immigration costs? also my first pay stub doesn't show the home-office allowance.
kyle (People Ops): welcome Ari! :wave: For Canada hires benefits typically start on the 1st of the month after 30 days for mid-month starts. You can opt out of supplemental plans (we'll need a signed waiver). Upload receipts to the HR portal under "expenses/moving" or "expenses/immigration" and tag them.
sana (Benefits): hi Ari — pension in Canada is RRSP matching and auto-enrol starts on the first payroll after 3 months. For dental/vision opt-outs we need the completed waiver and confirmation in the portal. Moving expenses: we reimburse reasonable work-related relocation costs; if it's a taxable relocation benefit we'll note it on the stub. please include invoices that show vendor and amount.
ari (New Hire): uploaded movers_invoice.pdf and visa_service_receipt.jpg to the portal; ticket HR-EXP-2104 created. Home-office stipend still missing on payroll portal.
hr-bot: Uploads received: movers_invoice.pdf, visa_service_receipt.jpg. Ticket HR-EXP-2104 created. Please include employee-id and banking last 4 digits for faster processing.
tom (Payroll): i see HR-EXP-2104. If receipts approved before payroll cutoff (Thu 12:00 ET) reimbursement goes in the next cycle; otherwise the following. Home-office stipend should be added to next run; if not, reply here with HR-EXP-2104 and i'll do a manual adjustment. If reimbursement is taxable, it'll appear as a separate line on the payslip.
ari (New Hire): thanks — one last Q: any provincial tax forms i need to worry about? i live in ON.
kyle (People Ops): nothing extra beyond standard Canadian payroll onboarding. We'll run CRA deductions and provincial tax for ON. You'll get a Canadian onboarding checklist DM with details. welcome aboard! :tada:
